ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all UBOs, directors, legal representatives, and material shareholders against (i) OFAC SDN and Sectoral Sanctions Identifications lists, (ii) the consolidated UN Security Council sanctions list, (iii) the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, (iv) the Colombian UIAF and Superintendencia de Sociedades risk and designated entities lists, (v) Procuraduría General disciplinary sanction records, (vi) the national terrorism-financing watchlist maintained under Law 1453 of 2011, and (vii) Parker/World-Check style adverse media and PEP databases. PEP status is defined under Superintendencia Financiera Circular Básica Jurídica; high-risk PEP scrutiny applies to foreign politically exposed persons related to the medical device procurement sector. The corporate service provider and the receiving Colombian financial institution must each issue a signed no-match certification before incorporation or account opening, and screening results must be retained for at least ten years. A negative result on any sanctions list or an unverified PEP connection is an automatic disqualifying event for appointment as legal representative.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) — official portal www.rues.org.co, coordinated with the local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá); the name availability certificate is denominated 'Certificado de Homonimia e Informe de Disponibilidad de Nombre' and is requested via the RUES electronic transaction module or in-person at the Chamber.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name of a Colombian S.A.S. must be expressed in Latin script; the denomination may be in Spanish or any other language using the Latin alphabet, but non-Latin scripts (Cyrillic, Arabic, CJK) must be transliterated into Latin characters and, where practicable, a Spanish reading equivalent must be registered. The statutory name must always end with the words 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada' or the acronym 'S.A.S.'. Names may include a free denominación (company descriptive element) but may not create de facto homonymy with an existing registered society under Article 116 of the Commercial Code and the clarifications issued by the Superintendencia de Sociedades. Diacritical marks are permitted; symbols such as '@', '#', and '%' are restricted; the address name cannot be misleading in relation to the registered corporate purpose.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a proposed name by the Cámara de Comercio, the incorporator shall file an administrative appeal titled 'Recurso de Reposición' before the same Chamber within ten (10) business days of notification, presenting supporting evidence of distinctiveness and non-similarity. If the Reposición is denied, the incorporator may within five (5) business days file a 'Recurso de Apelación' before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC), which shall decide the matter under the administrative procedure rules of Law 1437 of 2011. The name reservation certificate is not automatically renewable for the same name when it contains prohibited tokens; a fresh homonymy certificate must be obtained with a new name variant. Legal counsel should simultaneously reserve a secondary back-up name to avoid delay to the INVIMA Class III sanitary registration timeline.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible. The S.A.S. may register a virtual or serviced administrative office in Colombia as its domicilio social, provided the virtual provider maintains a real, verifiable physical location in the municipality of domicile, accepts official correspondence from DIAN, the Cámara de Comercio and supervisory authorities, and does not operate as a mere post-office box. However, for an ISIC 3250 Class III coronary drug-eluting stent manufacturer, the virtual office is not acceptable as the INVIMA-registered manufacturing site: INVIMA requires a dedicated physical plant with validated GMP/BPM cleanroom facilities. The registered domicile may remain administrative only if the manufacturing address is separately declared to INVIMA, the Cámara de Comercio, DIAN and the environmental licensing authority (ANLA or regional Corp). Failure to maintain physical substance at the declared plant will trigger administrative sanctions under Law 1258 of 2008, Law 222 of 1995 and Decree 4725 of 2005.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified at 85% — a mandatory INVIMA on-site GMP/BPM inspection is highly probable within the first twelve months after incorporation and always precedes release of the sanitary registration for a Class III drug-eluting coronary stent. Unannounced follow-up inspections occur on a risk-based cycle with 70% probability in the first two years. Additional unannounced inspections by the Superintendencia de Salud (health services), the SIC (consumer safety for implantables) and municipal environmental authorities carry a combined 45% inspection likelihood in year one. Foreign manufacturing purchase orders financed by letters of credit will increase bank-driven documentary compliance audits to approximately 60% probability.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008, arts. 5-22 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada); Codigo de Comercio, Decreto 410 de 1971, arts. 110, 352-373, 633-636; Decreto 019 de 2012 (simplified corporate registration regime); Ley 2069 de 2020 (entrepreneurship, reduced registration tariffs).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Camara de Comercio de Bogota (CCB) - Registro Unico Empresarial (RUES), coordinated with DIAN for NIT assignment; legal personality is acquired upon commercial registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitucion (private incorporation instrument), filed through the Formulario Unico de Registro (FUR) and pre-RUT; a public deed (escritura publica) is required only if real property or specially appraised in-kind assets are contributed as capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum statutory capital under Ley 1258 de 2008. Capital may be subscribed and paid in full or in installments within two (2) years from incorporation; no escrow account is statutorily mandated. Paid-in cash must be evidenced by deposit in the corporate bank account; in-kind contributions (laser micro-machining line, cleanroom fixtures) require a sworn appraiser's certificate. Foreign direct investment must be channeled through an authorized Colombian FX intermediary and reported to the Banco de la Republica via Formulario No. 2 (Declaracion de Cambio por Inversion Internacional).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 01 OF THE SOLE FOUNDER SHAREHOLDER OF ANDEAN BIOMED STENTS S.A.S., signed on [date]. THE SOLE FOUNDER SHAREHOLDER RESOLVES: FIRST: To constitute Andean BioMed Stents S.A.S., approve its bylaws, and ratify the subscription of 1,000,000 shares of COP 1,000 par value each, paid within the legal two-year term. SECOND: To adopt as registered office Calle 100 No. 19A-31, Bogota D.C., and instruct the legal representative to register the company with the Camara de Comercio de Bogota. THIRD: To appoint [Shareholder] as Legal Representative, [Name] as Chief Financial Officer, and [Name] as Quality and Regulatory Affairs Director, with powers conforming to Ley 1258 de 2008. FOURTH: To authorize opening corporate bank accounts and applying for NIT, RUT, municipal zoning, INVIMA, and environmental permits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Camara de Comercio de Bogota - Registro Unico Empresarial (RUES) electronic portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a homonymy request through the RUES web portal with three proposed corporate names in order of preference. The authority queries the national commercial registry and issues a Certificado de Homonimia valid for 30 calendar days confirming that no identical or confusingly similar SAS name is registered. Retain the certificate number and attach it to the incorporation instrument.
required_dossiers: Written name request (Formulario de Homonimia)
Copy of ID of the requesting shareholder or counsel
Payment receipt of the RUES query tariff
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any proposed name conflicts with an existing registration, the chamber returns a negative certificate; file again with the alternate names within the same request batch. No penalty attaches, but the certificate expiry date is not extended.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the incorporation instrument and approval of bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notario Publico of Bogota (when real property or in-kind equipment is contributed) or the sole founder; legal counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the private constitution document containing the bylaws, share subscription list, capital payment schedule not exceeding two years, registered address, duration, audit designations, and officers powers. If the production facility or laser micro-machining equipment is contributed as capital, execute before a notary and register the deed with the applicable property registry; otherwise a private document signed by the shareholders is sufficient and shall bear notarial signature certification to permit subsequent chamber registration.
required_dossiers: Draft bylaws and incorporation instrument
Subscribed capital schedule with proof of deposit or in-kind appraisal
Certificado de Homonimia
IDs or certificates of incorporation of all shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or chamber flags defects, amend by additional meeting minutes (acta aclaratoria) executed by the same parties; re-signature packages are processed within two business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial registration, NIT pre-assignment, and legalization of corporate books
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Camara de Comercio de Bogota - Registro Mercantil; DIAN for NIT pre-assignment via RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed incorporation instrument, Formulario Unico de Registro (FUR), and pre-RUT at the CCB service window. The chamber verifies the homonymy certificate, issues the Matricula Mercantil of the company and the establishment, assigns the NIT, and delivers the certificate of existence and legal representation. Immediately thereafter, submit the corporate books (shareholders register, minutes book, and individual investment ledger) for certification and sealing.
required_dossiers: Notarized or private incorporation instrument with certified signatures
FUR and pre-RUT
Certificado de Homonimia
Certificate of existence and legal representation of any corporate shareholders
Payment receipt of registration tariff
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chamber files observations (observaciones), the applicant has 10 business days to cure and maintain the original priority date; refusals may be appealed to the CCB administration and ultimately to the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive tax registration, electronic invoicing, and municipal ICA enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN - Direccion de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales; Secretaria Distrital de Hacienda de Bogota
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the Matricula Mercantil is active, file the definitive RUT at DIAN to obtain the NIT as employer responsible for income tax, VAT, and source withholding, and register for electronic invoicing (facturacion electronica). Through the RUT cross-reference, enroll with the municipal treasury for ICA (Impuesto de Industria y Comercio) at the industrial rate applicable to medical device manufacturing, and obtain the annual ICA declaration calendar and the corresponding operating card.
required_dossiers: NIT/RUT definitive confirmation
Certificate of existence and legal representation
Matricula Mercantil
Lease or title of the production facility with land-use certificate
Bank certification of the corporate account
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN detects discrepancies between RUES and RUT data, present the chamber certificate and file the RUT online correction; late-amendment penalties are waived if corrected within one month of detection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Land use and zoning clearance for Class III manufacturing facility
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Curaduria Urbana de Bogota / Secretaria Distrital de Planeacion
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the zoning certificate (certificado de uso del suelo) request for the premises, specifying Class III medical device manufacturing, ISO 7 cleanroom, laser micro-machining, and chemical storage. The Curaduria verifies consistency with the Plan de Ordenamiento Territorial (POT) and issues the clearance allowing industrial/laboratory use with occupancy load. Attach structural and fire-safety pre-clearance when the building houses hazardous chemicals.
required_dossiers: Certificado de uso del suelo application form
Land registry certificate or lease agreement
RUT and Matricula Mercantil
Floor plan and occupancy load calculation
Hazardous materials inventory and storage layout
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the intended use does not match the POT category, request an exceptional-use concept (uso excepcional) with mitigations or relocate to a compliant industrial district; the decision may be administratively appealed within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate bank account opening and foreign exchange registration (if foreign investment)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized Colombian commercial bank (account and FX intermediary); Banco de la Republica - Declaracion de Cambio (Formulario No. 2)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the certificate of existence and legal representation, bylaws, and shareholder/officer KYC to the banks AML-compliance desk to open a COP corporate checking account with SWIFT/Wire and documentary credit (LC) capabilities. Paid-in capital from non-resident shareholders must enter through the FX market; file the Declaracion de Cambio por Inversion Internacional within the statutory term, retain the declaration number for NIT updates and future dividend remittances, and record the investment in the shareholder ledger.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation (issued within 90 days)
NIT/RUT and Matricula Mercantil
Bylaws and first board resolution
Passport or certificate of incorporation of ultimate shareholders
Source-of-funds statement and bank references
FX investment declaration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank imposes enhanced due diligence for the high-risk MedTech/AML tier, supply audited corporate financials, an organizational chart, and a written MLRO risk assessment; the FX declaration can be amended via the same Formulario No. 2 within the permitted correction window.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: INVIMA - Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos, Subdireccion de Dispositivos Medicos y Otras Tecnologias
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro Sanitario de Dispositivo Medico Clase III (Drug-Eluting Coronary Stent) under Decreto 4725 de 2005, coupled with Certificado de Buenas Practicas de Manufactura (BPM) and Certificado de Capacidad de Produccion (CCP) issued by INVIMA

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Corporacion Autonoma Regional de Cundinamarca (CAR), with the Secretaria Distrital de Ambiente de Bogota for local industrial plant control; ANLA only if national-level project thresholds are triggered
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category II - Registration with Environmental Control Instruments: Simplified Environmental Statement (DAA), Permiso de Vertimientos, Permiso de Emisiones Atmosfericas, and Registro de Generadores de Residuos Peligrosos; full EIA study not required at ordinary laboratory and production scale
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: Res. 0631 de 2015 - pH 6.0-9.0, TSS <= 75 mg/L, BOD5 <= 100 mg/L, COD <= 250 mg/L, fats and oils <= 20 mg/L; municipal sewer discharge additionally subject to the aqueduct company limits. Air: Res. 2254 de 2017 - PM10 24h <= 75 ug/m3, PM2.5 24h <= 50 ug/m3; VOC and NMP solvent emissions from laser micro-machining abated by carbon adsorption or thermal oxidizer achieving stack VOC <= 20 ppm and workplace exposure <= ACGIH TLV. Hazardous waste: Ley 1252 de 2008 and Res. 1362 de 2007 - RESPEL manifest, labeling, and disposal exclusively through licensed carriers; polymer scrap segregated and stored in compliant containment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Conformidad de Medidas de Seguridad Humana y Proteccion contra Incendios - Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos de Bogota (fire extinguisher and sprinkler network, emergency lighting, signage, evacuation drills); structural and seismic safety certificate under Reglamento NSR-10 issued by a licensed structural engineer; SG-SST system implemented and registered under Res. 0312 de 2019, with high-risk class affiliation to a licensed ARL insurer, laser-safety interlocks, solvent fume extraction, ISO 7 cleanroom environmental monitoring, and pre-occupational medical surveillance for cleanroom and laser operators.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — the National Tax and Customs Authority. Administrative and electronic filing infrastructure: DIAN Sede Electrónica / MUISCA portal at www.dian.gov.co; e-invoicing and export declaration services via the DIAN Web Service (SOAP/API) and the VUCE foreign-trade single window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign entity incorporating a Colombian S.A.S.: (i) execute a power of attorney in favor of a Colombian-resident agent or the S.A.S.'s legal representative; (ii) where the foreign party requires an NIT, apply for a provisional NIT through DIAN's pre-registration service; (iii) complete the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) registration electronically or through authorized DIAN channels, recording the foreign address, the ISIC 3250 activity, common-regime IVA responsible status, and exporter status; (iv) obtain a DIAN-accredited digital signature certificate (certificado de firma electrónica) for e-invoicing; and (v) after inscription in the Chamber of Commerce, register the S.A.S. itself in the RUT with its own NIT and activate the authorized electronic-invoicing software through the DIAN Sede Electrónica.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (the S.A.S. is a separate and autonomous taxpayer with no pass-through option; the Colombian-resident S.A.S. is subject to worldwide income taxation; non-residents fall within Territorial_Scope, being taxed only on Colombian-source income; this S.A.S. is not in a Tax_Exempt_Zone unless it obtains later Zona Franca authorization).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no check-the-box or pass-through election; an S.A.S. cannot be disregarded for income tax purposes. Statutory elections relevant to this dossier: (i) opt-in to the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) where projected gross income is below 100,000 UVT and structural eligibility criteria are met, replacing ordinary income tax with a comprehensive turnover-based tax and simplifying IVA mechanics; (ii) election to apply the enhanced 175% income-tax deduction for science, technology and innovation investments under ET Art. 158-1, subject to prior approval; (iii) election of the Colombian Holding Company (CHC) regime where the S.A.S. is restructured as an eligible holding vehicle, exempting qualifying foreign-source dividends and capital gains; (iv) application for a DIAN Advance Pricing Agreement (APA) on the transfer-pricing model; and (v) application for Zona Franca status, a government-licensed election delivering a 20% CIT rate and tariff/VAT benefits.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas) — national value-added tax administered by DIAN, operating as a multi-stage credit-method consumption tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary threshold for legal persons. Every S.A.S. engaged in manufacturing and exporting medical devices is mandatorily registered in the RUT as a common-regime IVA responsible from the first taxable supply, irrespective of revenue. The simplified-regime turnover threshold for natural persons (COP 54,000 UVT, approximately COP 2,689 million at the 2025 UVT of COP 49,799) is not available to an S.A.S. Export zero-rating does not waive registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory national electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta). The S.A.S. must transmit each invoice, export invoice, and supporting document as XML to DIAN's Sede Electrónica via the DIAN Web Services (SOAP/API with X.509 digital signature). Exporters and taxpayers designated by DIAN, including exporters of high-risk goods, must obtain prior authorization (validación previa) before issuing documents; other taxpayers obtain validation within 48 hours. Each invoice receives a unique fiscal stamp code (CUFE for invoices; CUDS for supporting documents) and a QR code evidencing authenticity. Non-cleared invoices confer no input VAT credit, deduction, or export zero-rating benefit. Goods exports must be filed in the MUISCA customs module as an electronic export declaration, integrated with the VUCE foreign-trade single window and INVIMA sanitary export certification.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible movable goods are exempt from IVA and taxed at 0%, with credit on input VAT, under ET Art. 481 where: (i) the S.A.S. is a VAT-responsible common-regime exporter registered in the RUT with ISIC 3250 export activity; (ii) the goods physically leave Colombian customs territory through a definitive export operation accepted by DIAN; (iii) title passes abroad under the agreed INCOTERM; and (iv) the e-invoice is issued at 0% with the CUFE stamp and export annotation. Qualifying export services (e.g., calibration or engineering services for stent-processing equipment) are eligible where the beneficiary and the use of the service are abroad. Refund substantiation requires filing the bimestral VAT return showing the resulting saldo a favor and, upon DIAN documentary audit, proving export, shipment, and channeling of the export proceeds.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DIAN electronic Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) with acceptance status in MUISCA and the DEX number
Legalized commercial e-invoice (Factura Electrónica de Venta) issued at 0% with CUFE and QR code, bearing the export annotation
Packing list (Lista de Empaque) reconciled with the declared cargo
Original ocean Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / multimodal transport document evidencing definitive exit from Colombian customs territory
Bank Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas / certificación de canalización) issued by an authorized Mercado Cambiario intermediary
Certificate of Origin where preferential tariff treatment is claimed in the destination jurisdiction
INVIMA sanitary certificate, Good Manufacturing Practices (BPM/GMP) certificate for the Class III drug-eluting stent, and INVIMA pre-export authorization where required
Customs agency mandate or exporter registration certificate where the export is executed through a DIAN-licensed customs agent
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may scrutinize export zero-rating claims within the 5-year official-assessment window, extended to 10 years where fraud or fictitious documents are involved. A refused claim or false refund triggers: (i) claw-back of the refunded VAT plus moratory interest computed from the refund date; (ii) the inaccuracy penalty (sanción por inexactitud) of 100%–200% of the greater amount between the over-claimed refund and the determined deficiency; (iii) an additional 20% fine under ET Art. 670 where the refund was improperly collected; (iv) suspension or deregistration from DIAN e-invoicing and exporter programs; and (v) criminal liability for smuggling, false documentation, and tax evasion under Law 1762/2015 and the tax-criminal provisions of the Estatuto Tributario, carrying imprisonment of up to 8 years plus asset forfeiture. Failure to channel export proceeds through the Colombian exchange market within 180 days also triggers administrative foreign-exchange penalties under the Banco de la República regime.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia), acting jointly with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) for banking supervision and the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) for customs and exchange-control penalty enforcement. The normative base is the Régimen Cambiario under Resolution Externa No. 8 of 2000 of the Junta Directiva of Banco de la República, as amended.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia applies a rules-based foreign-exchange regime without quantitative restrictions on current-account transactions. Import and export settlements, technical-service fees, royalties, and freight payments are freely convertible, provided they are channeled through an authorized foreign-exchange market intermediary (intermediario del mercado cambiario). Capital-account transactions, including foreign direct investment (FDI) into a Colombian S.A.S., are not subject to pre-approval or amount ceilings, but the inflow must be settled through the foreign-exchange market and formally registered with Banco de la República via Formulario No. 3 (Declaración de Cambio por Inversiones Internacionales). Registration is the indispensable legal precondition for exercising the right to remit dividends, repatriate capital on dissolution, and access the official exchange market for future outflows. Unregistered FDI is treated as legally inexistent for exchange-control purposes and cannot be used to justify profit remittance through banking channels. Conversion of the inflow to Colombian pesos is performed at the representativa del mercado rate (TRM) published by Banco de la República; alternatively, the company may maintain foreign-currency deposit accounts. The only practical remittance hurdle for a Class III MedTech exporter is documentary: the bank must verify the tax settle-up of the dividend withholding obligation (retención por remesas) applicable under the reformed income-tax code (Ley 2277 de 2022) before effecting the wire to the non-resident shareholder.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters of goods must channel (canalizar) the full FOB invoice value of the export through the foreign-exchange market no later than four months from the date of the customs export declaration (Declaración de Exportación). If the exporter formally grants foreign-buyer credit, the term may be extended to the documented maturity of such credit, provided the supplier-financing arrangement is registered under the exchange-control rules. Channeling is evidenced by submission of Formulario No. 1 (Declaración de Cambio por Exportaciones de Bienes) to the receiving intermediary. Colombia imposes no mandatory conversion ratio: the exporter may retain the proceeds in an authorized foreign-currency deposit account or convert into Colombian pesos at the TRM. Retention offshore beyond the statutory channeling term, under-invoicing, or settlement outside the exchange market triggers fines imposed by DIAN, potential loss of customs-benefit programs, and bank compliance termination.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Colombia does not license offshore digital EMI or neo-bank platforms as foreign-exchange market intermediaries; they cannot execute the mandatory canalización, cannot file Formulario Nos. 1, 3, 4 or 5 with Banco de la República, and cannot issue Colombian-peso clearing instruments for customs-validated trade payments. Offshore platforms (Wise, Mercury, Airwallex) may only serve as auxiliary collection accounts for invoicing to foreign distributors where the statutory FX channeling has already been completed through a Colombian intermediary or where the transaction is foreign-to-foreign outside the Colombian exchange regime. A locally licensed neo-bank may be added as a secondary operational account, but the primary treasury relationship must reside with a tier-1 supervised commercial bank capable of letter-of-credit handling, FX declarations, and regulatory reporting for Class III medical-device trade flows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a High-Risk corporate client (Class III MedTech manufacturer with non-resident shareholders), the legal representative must complete an identity verification interview with the bank's compliance officer; in practice, an in-person appearance at a Colombian branch is required for execution of account-opening agreements and signature registration, with the exception that foreign-based directors may complete the interview through a verified video call before a Colombian consulate or at a recognized correspondent office. Remote-only onboarding is permitted by regulation under the SFC's Chapter 4 Customer Due Diligence rules, but tier-1 banks almost uniformly reject high-risk manufacturers without at least one physical branch visit or consular validation. The board must ratify the account-opening resolutions, and if a Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) is appointed, the auditor's identification and professional registration must also be presented.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity: the ultimate natural-person owner remains unidentified or sits behind a shell-holding structure in a high-risk, low-tax or non-cooperative jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificado de Existencias y Representación Legal issued by the Cámara de Comercio for every corporate layer from the Colombian S.A.S. up to the final natural persons; certified copies of passports for each UBO and director; apostilled and notarized sworn UBO affidavits; global sanctions screening clearance (OFAC, UN, EU, UK) for all parties; corporate-chart diagrams; and an absence-of-bearer-shares certificate for every intermediate entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Flow mismatch: high-frequency or high-value wires proposed by a newly incorporated S.A.S. with no transactional history and an atypical product profile
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed international distribution and OEM supply agreements with named counterparties; proforma invoices and purchase orders; INVIMA sanitary registration and authorization for the coronary drug-eluting stent system; ISO 13485 quality-management certificate; CE and FDA clearances or recognized notified-body certificates; Class III manufacturing license under Decree 4725 of 2005; projected trade-volume forecast and freight contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign capital injection arriving without pre-stamped foreign-investment exchange control documentation, creating a presumption of unregistered FDI
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Formulario No. 3 (Declaración de Cambio por Inversiones Internacionales) completed for the receiving intermediary; Banco de la República foreign-investment registration folio and certification; shareholder meeting minutes authorizing the capital contribution; wire origin evidence from the investor's foreign bank (SWIFT MT103 and account statements); the S.A.S. by-laws, NIT, and RUT certificate; and an audit letter confirming lawful source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and PEP triggers arising from the combination of medical-device manufacturing, export distribution chains, and foreign ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Product dossiers with INVIMA sanitary authorization, sterilization and biocompatibility certificates; end-user attestations or distribution compliance questionnaires confirming no sanctioned end-users; compliance policies for product classification, export-control, and anti-bribery; complete identity file of shareholders, directors and authorized signatories; and a six-month forecast of the company's trade transactions for the bank's transaction-monitoring system.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign shareholder initiates a SWIFT MT103 from its banking institution in USD or EUR to the Colombian S.A.S. account at the tier-1 local bank, quoting the beneficiary NIT, the beneficiary account number, the local bank SWIFT BIC, and the internal reference 'Inversión Internacional – Formulario No. 3'. On receipt, the Colombian bank credits the funds to the capital escrow account only after the legal representative signs Formulario No. 3, which the bank transmits to Banco de la República together with the investment data required to update the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales. The transaction is converted to Colombian pesos at the TRM if the company elects conversion; otherwise proceeds remain in a registered foreign-currency account. Verification is evidenced by the bank's MT103 advice, the stamped Formulario No. 3, the Banco de la República registration certificate, and the company's equity ledger entry. The S.A.S. minimum-capital requirement is nil under Law 1258 of 2008, but the subscribed capital stated in the by-laws must remain coherent with the actual wired amounts to avoid artificial-capital red flags.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements flow through three validated clearing rails: (1) Commercial letters of credit governed by UCP 600, used for import of polymer tubing, laser components, and sterilization services, with the Colombian bank as issuing bank and drafts maturing 60–90 days from presentation; (2) SWIFT MT103 clean payment wires for service imports, freight, insurance, and ancillary operating disbursements, declared through Formulario No. 5 (Declaración de Cambio por Importaciones de Servicios) and, for goods imports, Formulario No. 4; and (3) export collections under inbound letters of credit or MT103 remittances from foreign distributors, declared through Formulario No. 1 within the four-month channeling window. All payments exceeding USD 10,000 must pass through the foreign-exchange market with underlying customs declarations and invoice consistency checks against the DIAN export/import filing. The bank's forex desk manages the full documentary cycle, including presentation of shipping documents, packing lists, bill of lading, INVIMA compliance certificates, and certificate of origin.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright USD/COP currency forwards (forward a plazo) contracted with authorized Colombian foreign-exchange intermediaries, requiring a documented underlying import/export or FDI cash-flow exposure and strictly prohibiting speculative naked positioning.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) traded through the local bank's offshore desk, settled in Colombian pesos and supported by the same underlying trade-receivable or payable documentation, subject to Banco de la República's prudential reporting and capital-limits frameworks.

Cross-currency swaps (coupon swaps) between USD and COP matched to the company's multi-year import and stent-distribution cash-flow schedule, permissible where both legs are linked to registered commercial transactions and the swap is executed through a supervised market-intermediary.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of Commercial Registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Local Chamber of Commerce where the company is registered)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before March 31 for the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of 3% per month or fraction on the renewal fee, plus monetary interest. Persistent non-compliance leads to cancellation of the mercantile registration and judicial strike-off of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of Audited Annual Financial Statements and Management Report (Estados Financieros e Informe de Gestión)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio; also Superintendencia de Sociedades if the company exceeds surveillance thresholds
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after the annual shareholders' meeting; meeting must be held by March 31, making April 30 the customary final deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Daily fines up to COP 5 million imposed by the Superintendencia de Sociedades; administrative strike-off risk and legal inability to perform formal transactions if filing is omitted for two consecutive years.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Confirmation and Report (Reporte y Confirmación de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Superintendencia de Sociedades / UIAF (through the SIGGO platform or equivalent trade registry channel)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within one month following the shareholders' meeting; most commonly by April 30 of the following fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of up to COP 13 million for failure to report; presumption of non-compliance affecting corporate good standing and cross-border banking relationships.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registration and Sealing of Annual Shareholders' Meeting Minutes (Registro de Actas en el Libro de Actas y sellado)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (book authentication and seal for statutory registers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the meeting date; meeting mandated by March 31 annually
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to register and seal minutes invalidates the minutes for third- party reliance, generating corporate liability and impediments to capital transactions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory Revisor Fiscal (statutory audit) applies when at the end of the fiscal year total gross assets exceed 5,000 times the monthly minimum statutory wage (5,000 SMMLV) or gross annual revenues exceed 3,000 SMMLV (2024 thresholds approximately: assets USD 1.71 million; revenues USD 1.03 million). Also mandatory when expressly provided in the bylaws or when ordered by the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted under Colombian Law 1314 of 2009 (NIIF) – full IFRS (NIIF Plenas) for large entities, IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para Pymes) for medium-sized entities, according to Grupo classification by the CTCP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: All shareholding transfers must be recorded in the Libro de Registro de Accionistas and reflect the ultimate beneficial owners. Annual UBO confirmation updates identities, economic ownership percentages and voting rights; changes occurring during the year must be reported to the Superintendencia de Sociedades within one month after such transfer, and the consolidated confirmation is due by the annual report deadline (normally April 30).
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Libro de Registro de Accionistas (Register of Members)
Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas (Minutes Book of Shareholders' Meetings)
Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva (Minutes Book of Board of Directors)
Libro de Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (UBO Register)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 - USD 1,200 per year for corporate registered office/agent services in Colombia
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 - USD 15,000 per year for a medium-sized SAS subject to Revisor Fiscal and IFRS audit; additional INVIMA-related compliance audit fees may apply.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (Colombian corporate income tax rate for tax years following Ley 2277 of 2022)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday applies to ISIC 3250 medical device manufacturing. A preferential reduced rate of 20% is available only to authorized Zona Franca industrial users. Standard deductions include production costs, employment costs, depreciation of laser micro-machining equipment, and qualified research and development expenditures. Export-derived VAT and withholding tax may be zero-rated on eligible medical device exports.
